## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `Features`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `features`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **Features**.

## Step 2: Conditional breakpoints

1. <!-- manual: Right-click an existing breakpoint. -->
2. Select **Edit Breakpoint**.
3. <!-- manual: Enter a condition, for example order.total › 1000 or customer.tier == "premium". -->

## Step 3: Logpoints

1. <!-- manual: Right-click in the gutter. -->
2. Select **Add Logpoint**.
3. <!-- manual: Enter a message. Wrap expressions in braces, for example Processing order {order.id} with {items.length()} items. -->
